{{Term/Store|Ore|Ores|Series, OoS, ST, SS, ALBW, TFH, BotW|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Having Rupees doesn't do you any good. You need Ore Chunks!|Subrosian|OoS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 121,{{Exp Game|ST}} 122,{{Exp Game|SS}} 126,{{Exp Game|TFH}} & 131 {{Exp Game|ALBW}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|You got some {{Color SSHD|Gold|Eldin Ore}}! This hard concretion sparkles brightly. It also has lots of different uses.|N/A|SSHD}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Once we started breakin' up the rock here, we found that it's rich in {{Color BotW|Blue|ore}}. So I've decided to open up shop! I'm not sure why we have so much ore here, but maybe it's because we're close to {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}}. Anyway, these here are freshly mined. Be sure to buy a whole bunch!|Pelison|BotW}}</ref>
